The incident INC‑20261108‑151932 was detected at 15:19:32 Z when cleanroomd flagged ransomware on the acme‑fs file share. Eighteen seeded files were encrypted, and two new ransom‑note files (LOCKSTAR‑WALLPAPER.png, README_RESTORE_FILES.txt) appeared. The patient‑intake, payroll, contracts and VPN‑credential data assets are all marked locked, accessed and modified. Forensics and Hunter report the alert may be a false positive from an authorized backup test, but the ransom note and encrypted files indicate real impact. Legal clocks are running: GDPR has 71 hours left, HIPAA 59 days, Texas 60 days. The containment proposal is to isolate the host acme‑fs from the network.  

First, verify the backup‑test claim with the responsible team; if the encryption is genuine, approve the isolation proposal to stop further spread.
